Pull Request template for GreenCharge

## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. Describe the problem and the solution.

## Related issue

Closes # (issue number)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have added tests where applicable
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly

## How to test

Provide instructions to reproduce or test the changes.
